column1: # The `just test-memfd-x86` scenario: the anonymous shared-memory object, driven
# One step per line, as `tools/smoke/scenario.tsv` documents: the command, a tab, and the
# whole line its output must produce.
# `memfdtest` reports a distinct failure code per step, so a gate failure points at the call
# that broke (1–4 create/ftruncate/fstat, 5–7 two mappings of one object, 8–13 the descriptor
# and the mappings agreeing, 14–20 the same across a fork) rather than at "memfd did not
# work". The one line below is only printed when every step passed.
